description: Search organizer profiles enriched from event data. Returns organizer names, source, website/contact details, Instagram profile URL plus handle, and scrape status.

limit.description: Maximum number of organizers to return (default 20, max 100)

missing_contacts_only.description: Only return organizers missing website, email, phone, or Instagram (default false)

query.description: Search by organizer name, website, email, or Instagram handle

source.description: Filter by event source (e.g., facebook, eventbrite, lu.ma)

name: search_organizers
